text.description_html:
Fusion PH-E5, St. Charles Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder

The St. Charles Toilet Tissue Holder is easy to install and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. It comes in either medium bronze or oil rubbed bronze finishes. The St. Charles Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder features fleur-de-lis designs on the mounts, making it a great way to add old-world elegance to your home.

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Saint Charles Collection Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually



Item Discontinued. See available Bathroom Hardware
